# PRD: Search improvements

## Goal
Make search better.

## Acceptance
- Search should be fast enough for most users.
- Results should be relevant and high quality.
- The experience should handle typos gracefully in the common case.
- Errors should be handled sensibly.

## Out of scope
Re-indexing pipeline changes.
